name: pi-ext
description: Goal, Codex compaction, Fast Mode, UI, subagent, MCP, and permissions extensions for Pi Coding Agent
license: (MIT AND Apache-2.0 AND MPL-2.0 AND Unicode-3.0)
author: Wang Xuyang

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && tsc -p ./extensions/codex-compact/tsconfig.json && node ./scripts/codex-compact-media.mjs copy && tsc -p ./extensions/openai-fast-mode/tsconfig.json && tsc -p ./extensions/codex-ui/tsconfig.json && tsc -p ./extensions/mcp/tsconfig.json && tsc -p ./extensions/permissions/tsconfig.json && tsc -p ./extensions/subagent/tsconfig.json && tsc -p ./extensions/goal/tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p ./extensions/codex-compact/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p ./extensions/openai-fast-mode/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p ./extensions/codex-ui/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p ./extensions/mcp/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p ./extensions/permissions/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p ./extensions/subagent/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p ./extensions/goal/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm run build && pnpm run package:check
scripts.codex-compact:quality:check: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 conda run -n codex-py312 python -m unittest discover -s extensions/codex-compact/__tests__ -p 'quality_*_test.py'
scripts.web-search:check: pnpm exec tsc -p extensions/codex-search/tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm exec vitest run extensions/codex-search/__tests__ && conda run -n codex-py312 python prototypes/web-search-prototype/__tests__/smoke.py --production --restart && conda run -n codex-py312 python prototypes/web-search-prototype/__tests__/smoke.py --production --fullscreen --restart
scripts.prototype:web-search:check: node --test prototypes/web-search-prototype/__tests__/*.test.mjs && conda run -n codex-py312 python prototypes/web-search-prototype/__tests__/smoke.py && conda run -n codex-py312 python prototypes/web-search-prototype/__tests__/smoke.py --fullscreen
scripts.goal:footer:check: conda run -n codex-py312 python ./extensions/goal/__tests__/footer-tui-driver.py && conda run -n codex-py312 python ./extensions/goal/__tests__/footer-tui-driver.py --fullscreen && conda run -n codex-py312 python ./extensions/goal/__tests__/footer-tui-driver.py --native && conda run -n codex-py312 python ./extensions/goal/__tests__/footer-tui-driver.py --native --fullscreen
scripts.tool-status:check: pnpm run build && conda run -n codex-py312 python ./prototypes/tool-status-prototype/smoke.py --production --play --restart && conda run -n codex-py312 python ./prototypes/tool-status-prototype/smoke.py --production --play --fullscreen --restart && conda run -n codex-py312 python ./prototypes/tool-status-prototype/smoke.py --production --lowpower --restart && conda run -n codex-py312 python ./prototypes/tool-status-prototype/smoke.py --production --lowpower --fullscreen --restart && conda run -n codex-py312 python ./prototypes/tool-status-prototype/smoke.py --production --mcp-only --restart
scripts.prototype:tool-status:check: pnpm exec vitest run extensions/codex-ui/__tests__/tool-status-prototype.test.ts && conda run -n codex-py312 python ./prototypes/tool-status-prototype/smoke.py && conda run -n codex-py312 python ./prototypes/tool-status-prototype/smoke.py --fullscreen && conda run -n codex-py312 python ./prototypes/tool-status-prototype/smoke.py --before && conda run -n codex-py312 python ./prototypes/tool-status-prototype/smoke.py --play && conda run -n codex-py312 python ./prototypes/tool-status-prototype/smoke.py --play --fullscreen
scripts.prototype:goal-footer:check: pnpm exec tsc -p ./prototypes/goal-footer-prototype/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec vitest run extensions/goal/__tests__/footer-prototype.test.ts && conda run -n codex-py312 python ./prototypes/goal-footer-prototype/smoke.py
scripts.prototype:mcp-ui:check: pnpm exec tsc -p ./prototypes/mcp-status-ui-prototype/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec vitest run extensions/mcp/__tests__/status-ui-prototype.test.ts
